messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — high 502/504 rate detected at api-gateway (edge, eu-west-1) for the last 3m. Error rate 18% on /v1/generate and streaming endpoints. Paging sre-alyssa and eng oncall. Priority: P1. :rotating_light:

sre-alyssa: acked. I'm on it. joining call.

mike-eng: seeing identical spike from our telemetry — spike aligns with traffic increase from partner X (long tail streaming connections). Gateway errors are 502/504, not 5xx from backend app logs so far.

sasha-platform: I'm checking LB health and proxy pools, starting with edge proxy pool eu-west-1-a.

sre-alyssa: quick checklist: 1) confirm proxies overloaded or backend timeouts 2) circuit-breaker / reject-big-body toggle 3) fallback routing to regional pool 4) status update req.

mike-eng: running a quick curl to gateway from bastion — getting 502 with this header response:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
x-edge-proxy: proxy-3b
x-request-id: abcd-1234

{"error":"upstream connect error or disconnect"}
```

sasha-platform: LB metrics: proxy-3b showing 90% CPU, epoll lag and backlog. New connections are spiking. The backend upstream pods for v1-gen are fine (CPU 40%). Looks like proxy heap/backpressure.

sre-alyssa: action — enable temporary ingress circuit-breaker rule to reject requests with large chunked bodies to streaming endpoints. Also enable routing fallback to regional pool eu-central-1 for new sessions. Applying now.

sasha-platform: applied policy set: ingress/cb/reject-chunked=true and route-fallback=eu-central-1 for /v1/stream*. Confirming via config push: OK.

mike-eng: telemetry now shows drop in proxy-3b new connections and 502 rate dropping to 9% in the last minute. Backend 200 rates unchanged. Good sign.

jordan-product: any customer impact? which customers affected? need to prepare a status page blurb.

natalie-support: Support triage: partner X reports partial failures for long streaming sessions only; short requests (non-stream) mostly unaffected. Impact: estimated 12 customers, potential data loss on in-progress streams.

status-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-1492 and status page draft at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-1492 (private draft). Suggested message: "We are investigating elevated 502/504 errors affecting long streaming requests in eu-west. Mitigation in progress."

sre-alyssa: rolling a soft restart of proxy-3b (graceful drain) to flush stuck epoll backlog. Doing a 30s drain window and rotate.

sasha-platform: drain started on proxy-3b -> pool drained and replaced by proxy-3c. Observability: connection backlog cleared.

mike-eng: 502/504 rate now down to 3% and trending to normal. Latency normalizing. We should keep circuit-breaker on for 10m and monitor.

jordan-product: preparing status page update: "Mitigation in place. Some streaming sessions may have been affected; we will post more details after post-incident analysis."

natalie-support: sending proactive note to Partner X contacts: short heads-up and support ticket opened.

sre-alyssa: next steps: 1) keep cb for 15m 2) collect tcpdump + proxy logs for proxy-3b 3) run churn test to replicate if needed 4) if stable, lift fallback routing and CB after 15m.

mike-eng: capturing logs now: /var/log/proxy/3b/error.log and core dump if exists. Uploading to incident ticket.

sasha-platform: exporting metrics graph (502 rate, conn backlog, proxy cpu) and attaching to INC-2026-1492.

status-bot: Status updated (public): "Investigating — elevated 502/504 errors for streaming endpoints in eu-west; mitigation underway. Service degradation for long-lived streaming sessions."

sre-alyssa: received enough stabilization signal, will leave CB and routing in place for monitoring window. If stable for 20m, we'll do controlled rollback of config.

mike-eng: note for postmortem: investigate why proxy-3b epoll backlog surfaced while backend healthy — likely connection handling regression in recent proxy release v2.14. Pinning suspected commit hash in ticket for triage.

jordan-product: tagging PM slug and listing affected customers. We'll schedule post-incident customer follow-up for Partner X.

natalie-support: support ticket updated with mitigation steps and ETA for full resolution.

sre-alyssa: handoff in 30m to overnight oncall (sre-night) with detailed runbook in INC-2026-1492. Leaving channel but monitoring for 15m. :white_check_mark:

sasha-platform: ack. I'll keep watches on proxy pool and escalate if 502 > 5% again.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: on-call handoff scheduled at 1765552800 to @sre-night.

sre-alyssa: closing thread once postmortem ticket created and rollback plan validated. Thanks all. :heart:
